lines.text: Many learners say: Swim is fun.
When an action is the subject, use swimming, not swim.

data.why: When an action is the subject, use swimming, not swim.

native.tip: Si un verbo es el sujeto, añade “-ing”. En español usamos el infinitivo: “nadar es”.
native.caption: En español “nadar es divertido”, pero en inglés va con -ing 🏊 No “Swim is fun.”, sino “Swimming is fun.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “Dancing”. Verbo como sujeto: -ing. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: When a verb is the subject, add “-ing”. The phrase “nadar es” becomes “swimming is” in English.
en.caption: Learners say “nadar es divertido”, but English uses -ing. Not “Swim is fun.”, but “Swimming is fun.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
